## August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 149)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and British networks, BBC correspondent Robert Reid's historic live recording under sniper fire with General Charles de Gaulle at Notre-Dame Cathedral during the Liberation of Paris, Everett Sloane in Fletcher Markle's *Studio One* production of *The Hunted*, Red Skelton's wartime salvage drive on *The Old Gold Show*, U.S. Navy Seabees in action on *Now Hear This*, and Douglas Edwards on *World News Today* (1942–1951):
